blocks.text: In a large-scale global deployment of Zero Trust Branch, managing each site individually is time-consuming and prone to errors. Zscaler provides a set of templates so that you can build sites quickly. You can also create custom templates based on the default set. Templates support both standalone and high availability (HA) configurations.
After you have created or selected the template you want to use, see Adding a Site to create a site using that template.
To start creating Zero Trust Branch sites, Zscaler provides templates for virtual machine (VM) and supported devices in both standalone and HA configurations. To learn more, see Deployment Overview.
You cannot delete or edit default templates, but you can clone them.
You can perform the following actions from the Templates page (Zero Trust Branch > Resources > Templates):

blocks.item: Add a New Template
To add a new template:
Click Add Template in the upper-right corner.
See image.
In the Add Template drawer:
Name: Enter a name to identify the template.
Primary WAN DNS: Enter the IP address of the primary WAN DNS server for this template.
Secondary WAN DNS: (Optional) Enter the IP address of the secondary WAN DNS server for this template.
DHCP Service: Select an option from the drop-down menu:
Internal DHCP Server: To use the appliance as an internal DHCP server.
DHCP Relay: To use the appliance as a DHCP relay. The DHCP requests are forwarded to an external server.
Mixed (Per VLAN Server/Relay): To configure DHCP services individually for each VLAN, using the appliance as either an internal DHCP server or DHCP relay.

Default DHCP Mode for VLAN: Select the default DHCP mode (Internal DHCP Server or DHCP Relay) that must be used for a VLAN. This option applies only when the Mixed (Per VLAN Server/Relay) option is selected as DHCP service.
Deployment Type: Select the deployment mode this template will be used for:
standalone: For sites with a single appliance.
standard_mode_ha: For a standard HA cluster operating in active-standby mode.

enhanced_mode_ha: For an Advanced HA (WAN Edge HA) cluster that supports an active-active configuration for WAN links. To learn more, see Creating a Zero Trust Branch Enhanced WAN Edge High Availability Cluster.
Platform [Appliance-1]: Select the platform this template will be used for: either vm for a VM or the device type.
Platform [Appliance-2]: If you select an HA deployment, select the platform for the secondary gateway. You can have a different platform (e.g., VM for an appliance) for the secondary gateway.
NAT Enabled: Enable if your Zero Trust Branch appliance uses NAT to route traffic leaving the branch appliance toward the non-Zero Trust Branch network.
See image.
Click Save.
Edit a Template
To edit a template:
Click the name of the template you want to edit.
On the template details page, manage the following tabs:
Overview: View the template properties and the number of sites currently using the template.
Settings: Configure global behavior for associated sites:
DHCP Service: Choose whether the template functions as an Internal DHCP Server, DHCP Relay, or Mixed (Per VLAN Server/Relay).

Default DHCP Mode for VLAN: Select the default DHCP mode (Internal DHCP Server or DHCP Relay) that must be used for a VLAN. This option applies only when the Mixed (Per VLAN Server/Relay) option is selected as DHCP service.
NAT: Use the toggle to enable or disable NAT configuration.
DNS: Manage the WAN DNS configuration. Configure the Primary WAN DNS and Secondary WAN DNS IP addresses.
Click Save after making any changes in this tab.
See image.
Interfaces: Manage the interfaces for the template gateways. Click Add to configure new interfaces or click the Gear icon to delete an interface. To learn more, see Understanding Bonding Interfaces.
Security Policy: Manage the security policies for the template. To learn more, see Configuring Security Policies.
Forwarding Policy: Manage the forwarding rules for the template. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Policies.
Clone a Template
To clone a template:
Click the Gear icon next to a template and select Clone.
Enter a name for the cloned template and click Save.
Delete a Template
To delete a template:
Click the Gear icon next to a template and select Delete.
In the Delete dialog box, enter DELETE and click Confirm to delete the template.
